contract: Each entry: file (path under slopbench/pages/), label ('ai' | 'human'), source ('fixture' | 'archetype' | 'authored'), note (the idiom the page represents).
description: 30 labelled single-file HTML pages for benchmarking AI-design-slop detectors. 'label' is the ground truth: 'ai' = a page written in the idiom an AI builder or template produces by default; 'human' = a page written with deliberate, non-template design decisions. 'source' records provenance honestly: 'fixture' and 'archetype' pages are copied verbatim from this repository's own test material, 'authored' pages were written for this benchmark by the deslop maintainer. No page was scraped from the live web.
